_comment: Targeted search sweep, used only when TAVILY_API_KEY is set. This is NOT a general news sweep — RSS covers that far better. It exists for one reason: many town, county and state-legislature sites publish no RSS at all, which can leave the profile's highest-priority monitoring area with no primary source. Domain-scoped queries reach those sites directly, which is why results can honestly carry source_class 'primary'. Free tier is 1,000 searches/month; this uses ~9/day.

_fields.id: Becomes the retrieval track for scoring and budgeting.
_fields.include_domains: Restricts results to these hosts. When set to official sites, the source_class below is justified; without it, results are unverifiable and must stay 'established' or lower.
_fields.source_class: Quality tier for results. Only claim 'primary' when include_domains restricts to official sources.
_fields.lean: Almost always 'primary' here, since these are government records rather than framing.
